newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 8.096 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 8.096 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Saturday the cotton crop had reached a provisional 8.096 million 375-lb bales by January 30, against 9.049 million bales at the same date last year.
It said mills had bought 6.279 million bales, down from 6.494 million in the year-ago period, while exporters had picked up only 3,900 bales against 956,900 bales last year.
A total of 1.813 million unsold bales were stocked at ginning factories, compared to 1.599 million bales in the year-ago period, the Corporation said.

Officials estimate the total 1996/97 (July-June) crop, damaged by pest in the main Punjab cotton belt, will be anywhere between 8.5 and 9.0 million bales, less than earlier forecasts of 10 million bales and last year's 9.96 million bales.
